mathematical_statement: For any finite Dirichlet polynomial F(t) = sum_{n<=N} c_n e^{-it log n} and smooth window W in C_c^infty(R), the inner product <F_0, ddot F_0>_W decomposes exactly into diagonal m=n and off-diagonal m!=n components: <F_0, ddot F_0>_W = sum_{n<=N} c_n bar d_n int W(t) [ -(a-it) log n + (a-it)^2 (log n)^2 ] dt + sum_{m!=n} c_m bar d_n int W(t) e^{-it log(m/n)} [ -(a-it) log n + (a-it)^2 (log n)^2 ] dt. The off-diagonal terms are strictly non-zero for finite windows, proving that knowledge of window variance <t^2>_W alone does not diagonalize a finite-window inner product.

quantified_variables.name: W
quantified_variables.domain: W in C_c^infty(R), W >= 0, int W = 1

hypotheses: F_0(t) = sum_{n<=N} c_n e^{-it log n}
ddot F_0(t) = sum_{n<=N} d_n(t) e^{-it log n} where d_n(t) = c_n (log tau)^2 [ -(a-it) log n + (a-it)^2 (log n)^2 ]
object_studied: Finite-window Dirichlet polynomial grade second-variation inner product
normalization_and_fourier_convention: Centered coordinates z = s - 1/2 = a + it; tau = 2pi; Fourier transform hat{W}(xi) = int W(t) e^{-it xi} dt
measure_and_window: Admissible smooth test window W(t) dt
order_of_limits: Finite sum N < infinity; 1D integration over compact support of W
exact_conclusion: <F_0, ddot F_0>_W = (Diagonal sum) + (Off-diagonal sum); matches 1D numerical quadrature within certified tolerance; |Off-diagonal| > 0 generically
logical_negation: <F_0, ddot F_0>_W = (Diagonal sum) for all admissible finite windows (FALSIFIED by non-vanishing of Fourier transforms hat{W}(log(m/n)) for m!=n)
falsification_attempts: Evaluated 2-term and 4-term Dirichlet polynomials under Gaussian and smooth bump windows
Verified discrepancy |Full - Diag| > 0 against adaptive Gauss-Kronrod quadrature
Tested that off-diagonal terms vanish only in the infinite Cesaro limit T -> infinity, which is decoupled from finite window variance
external_sources: Montgomery & Vaughan (1974), Hilbert's inequality, J. London Math. Soc. (2) 8, 73-82
Besicovitch (1932), Almost Periodic Functions, Cambridge Univ. Press
remaining_analytic_dependencies: Infinite series extension to completed xi-function (OBL-DERIVE-FULL-WINDOWED-ZETA-CROSS-TERM)
